name: SmartArtNodes
description: Represents a collection of nodes within a SmartArt diagram.
remarks: These nodes correspond directly to semantic elements contained within the data model of the graphic.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SmartArtNodes object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SmartArtNodes object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Retrieves the number of SmartArtNode objects contained within the SmartArtNodes collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Retrieves a SmartArtNode object at the specified index or with the specified unique Id.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies either an integer representing the index or a string representing the location of the SmartArtNode object.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new SmartArtNode object to the diagram with specified text.
